proposal: Publish a bounded tri-state chatAvailable:true/false/null from the exact canonical player document and matching current live video/channel identity. True requires the actual official liveChatRenderer or exact matching official chat iframe; false requires the exact observed official disabled-message structure and one of the two verified fixed system messages. Missing/malformed watch data, unknown language/message, empty shell or unrelated iframe is unknown. Do not infer a negative from missing data. Existing independent native chat visibility remains separate from archive availability.

Separate immutable canonical channel identity from producer-start state in the YouTube receiver binding. Unknown may bind the verified channel and establish pending chat preservation without starting a process or consuming the once-only producer. Explicit unavailable is a distinct current observation, not a transport failure or a completed empty archive. A later exact-identity positive observation may start the one existing public chat producer once; repeated positive/unknown/negative observations cannot spawn another producer or reset it. A real started producer's failure is not automatically retried by this correction.

Before an unknown/unavailable channel binding becomes eligible for video archive admission, mark its SharedChat as requiring verified coverage. Start one existing15second preparation deadline once for unknown/preparing state; repeated status ticks must not reset it. Explicit unavailable can permit video-only capture immediately; unresolved unknown after the original bound can permit video-only capture with StatusUnknown. A later positive handshake may benefit future archives but cannot remove a partial reason from an already-attached archive or rewrite old proofs. No video pause, second video source, historical data rewrite or manufactured completeness.

Preserve exact source, native document epoch, canonical video and channel, active receiver, shutdown and owner gates. Serialize identity/availability admission through the receiver binding lock. In the native host recheck epoch under its existing admission/arm ordering before changing binding, so a stale document cannot start a new producer. Account refresh may not reset an already-started producer, recording or global account state in this batch.

Keep durable complete/partial/unknown schema and original retention rules unchanged. Public source-unavailable status must remain visible and distinguishable from preparing; raw external system text is not forwarded to diagnostics/UI. Existing bootstrap proof, bounded initial history, first-segment timeline, sticky failure and recent-loss accounting are not weakened.

Update only YouTube status projection, the narrow native status/binding path, SharedChat YouTube preparation/availability methods, focused tests and QA expectation mapping if its existing bool assertion requires the new unknown value. Do not change SOOP, CHZZK, account navigation, fullscreen/input/layout, scheduler intent or any cleanup authority. Root owns all actual application operations and Cargo.
